about.description: 8 Reale is a hidden speakeasy cocktail bar in Orange Beach, AL, transporting guests back to the days of Prohibition with a modern twist. Skilled mixologists craft everything from classic cocktails like the Old Fashioned and Sidecar to contemporary creations featuring fresh, local ingredients. The bar offers a unique experience defined by mystery, ambiance, and craftsmanship — all behind a hidden vaulted door.
about.elevator_pitch: A secretive coastal speakeasy tucked behind a hidden vaulted door, where expert mixologists craft Prohibition-era classics and modern cocktails in an atmosphere dripping with intrigue and sophistication.
about.vibe: Mysterious, sophisticated, Prohibition-era speakeasy with coastal flair
about.insider_tip: Look for 'Today's Secret Code' on the website — this speakeasy keeps its hidden-door concept alive with a daily password system.
